title: Instant Pet Names
description: Instantly name your pets as soon as you tame them, no Name Tag required.
body:
Allows you to name Wolves, Cats, Parrots, and all Horse variants as soon as you tame them.

Opens up a dialog box that can be closed/skipped by pressing Esc.

The game will pause when choosing a name in Singleplayer, but it will NOT pause in multiplayer.

Further renaming requires normal use of a name tag.

Supports Multiplayer.

Made for Java 1.21.6.
